name: UJIIndoorLoc

map_x.instruction: Estimate the indoor map x coordinate of this WiFi scan at Universitat Jaume I.
map_x.field_description: observed_ap_rssi_dbm maps detected WiFi access point identifiers to received signal strength in dBm. An omitted access point was not detected. Map coordinates are in the source campus reference system.

map_y.instruction: Estimate the indoor map y coordinate of this WiFi scan at Universitat Jaume I.
map_y.field_description: observed_ap_rssi_dbm maps detected WiFi access point identifiers to received signal strength in dBm. An omitted access point was not detected. Map coordinates are in the source campus reference system.

grouping_rule: User, phone and UTC day; overlaps in WiFi input are linked in standardization.
split_policy: Official reference file as train and official validation/test file as test; original source filename retained.
quality_findings: 76 training rows have no detected access points. All source evaluation occurrences are retained, including multiplicity after deduplication.
Both coordinate components share the same input and group. Published coordinates in metres are copied without reprojection. Unit reference: https://doi.org/10.1109/IPIN.2014.7275492
No campus maps, real MAC addresses, floor or space identifiers, companion coordinate, user or phone attributes are included in model input.
deduplication_rule: Same task, normalized input, normalized label AND official split; preserve all source_refs. Across-split copies retained and flagged, same-input dependencies unioned. Different labels retained.
sample_id_rule: sha256([task_id,input_hash,label,split]) first 24 hex; official split included to preserve split occurrences.
